source_correspondence: Cam report evaluates current SCAD functions. Driver and stop scripts reconstruct their explicit planar dimensions; final SCAD dimensions were checked against the values listed below.

cam_contact.json.scope: Actual SCAD functions; planar geometric samples only. No friction, spring forces, strength, or physical validation.

driver_reset_path.json.scope: Driver-to-ratchet geometric existence path only; other assembly parts, force, friction, springs and tolerances not simulated

stop_setback_candidate.json.scope: 2D nominal rigid geometry only; forces, springs, friction, tolerances and axial clearances untested

conclusions: A sampled driver-to-ratchet non-overlap path exists for the final tapered nose from lift 8.3 mm / wheel 36 degrees / driver opening 0 degrees, through lift -4.5 mm, to lift 0 mm / opening 0 degrees. Planning uses the encompassing old rectangular nose. The maximum planned opening of 12.35 degrees is a conservative feasible bound within the 15-degree limit, not the minimum required opening for the tapered nose. All 4671 recorded nodes and midpoints were checked against the actual tapered nose without overlap.

The fixed stop has a sampled connected non-overlap opening path through one 36-degree tooth cycle and can close at the indexed phase. Its nominal reverse contact begins at approximately 0.8426 degrees; ball detents provide positional indexing.
The actual SCAD cam polygon is valid and its sampled contact error with the 1.5 mm follower is at most 0.00133 mm. Maximum sampled pressure angle is 51.30 degrees.
not_established: That passive springs or friction select the constructed geometric path automatically.
